name: protection_funded_jail_list
description: Test 31 (PR8): DoOccupantRemoved (police, buildings only) first removes and releases the first matching entry of the locally-funded-jail list with no other condition, then handles the jail list. Jail 21 (capacity 1000, item local 1.0) inserted: in both lists (2 references). The police record (v8: 2 + 98 base + 8 jail department + funded list at 108: count 1, ref at 112; jail list at 120: count 1, ref at 124) is patched to an empty jail list (count 0 at 120, the 8-byte ref deleted) and read into a fresh simulator: funded list [21], jail list []. Removing 21 releases and erases the funded entry (its reference count drops by one; the harness counts the simulators' AddRef and Release calls, not references the stream resolver hands out, so after the read 21 still shows the 2 taken by the first simulator) even though it is no longer a listed jail; the jail list step finds nothing, so no RemoveLocallyFundedObject and no Recalculate (capacity and population stay as read). Removing building 30, in neither list, changes nothing: no events, same lists and references. Layout derived by hand from 11.
